summary: Divorce appeal under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955; irretrievable breakdown of marriage after 25 years' separation; multiple criminal cases filed by wife, resulting in acquittals; High Court reversed Trial Court's divorce decree; Supreme Court exercises Article 142 power to dissolve marriage due to no possibility of reconciliation; repeated mediation attempts failed; cruelty via persistent litigation recognized per Naveen Kohli and K. Srinivas Rao; marriage sustained only on paper.
legal_provisions_cited: Hindu Adoption and Maintenance Act, 1956 s.18
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; marriage dissolved on grounds of irretrievable breakdown; decision rendered pursuant to Article 142 of the Constitution.
